title: Encroachment: Protecting a Property You Cannot Visit
description: Vacant plots and houses are the easiest to encroach. How owners abroad can lower the risk, and what to do if someone moves in. Book a free property check.
h1: Encroachment: how to protect a property you cannot visit
lead: Encroachment rarely starts dramatically. It starts with a gate left open and no one noticing.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

bullets: Fence or wall the boundary and keep it in repair
Put up a board with the owner’s contact details
Have someone visit regularly and photograph the site
Pay property tax and keep the records current
Know your neighbours and give them a contact

paras: Act quickly and in writing. Do not confront anyone yourself. Take dated photos, gather your title documents and speak to a lawyer. Long unchallenged occupation can create legal complications, which is why delay is the real danger.
Our [management service](/nri-property-management-pondicherry) includes scheduled visits with photo reports for plots as well as houses.

blocks.p: Book a free property check and we will set up a visit schedule.
